original.question: The area of Billie's rectangular bedroom is 360 square feet. If the length of the room is 3 yard(s), what is the perimeter of the room in feet?
original.answer:
The length of the room is 3 yard(s) * (3 feet / 1 yard(s)) = <<3*(3/1)=9>>9 feet.
The width of the room is 360 square feet / 9 feet = <<360/9=40>>40 feet.
The room's perimeter is 2(40+9) = 98 feet
